cc:Work.dc:title: H200 · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · Marlin W4A16
cc:Work.dc:description: Stock SGLang AR and DFlash2, stock vLLM DFlash2 and the AX tree/chain on one H200 for NVFP4 at one and eight clients. Stock vLLM leads; the tree is second at one client.
